description.p: Chismoso is a small desktop app for Frigate, the open-source network video recorder. It shows your cameras live, lets you scrub through recordings on a timeline, and turns hours of footage into short timelapses.

ul.li: Live grid of your cameras, arranged in views you build by dragging cameras onto a wall that fills the window
Zoom into the grid without opening a camera; see at a glance which cameras are live, connecting or offline
A timeline of recordings, alerts and detections, with synchronized playback of every camera in a view
Clips and timelapses of one or several cameras, made by your Frigate server
Desktop notifications for alerts, with a picture
Pan, tilt and zoom for PTZ cameras
Keep me signed in without storing your password

description.p: Chismoso talks only to your own Frigate server. It is not affiliated with the Frigate project.

screenshot.caption: Live view of several cameras with the recordings timeline
Alert notification with a picture from the camera

ul.li: Views: tabs above the grid; drag cameras anywhere on the grid to place, swap or resize them
Zoom into the grid with the mouse wheel or a pinch
Every camera shows whether it is live, connecting or offline
Much faster start, and every picture shows at once
